source: paraphrase: The universe operates on a principle of cause and effect.
target: All things in the world have a cause and a result.

source: paraphrase: She must have endured a similar experience.
target: She must have gone through them too.

source: paraphrase: In the faint glow, I noticed remnants of weeping upon her somewhat indulgent countenance.
target: In the pale light, I could see that traces of tears still remained on her somewhat wanton face.

source: paraphrase: Regretting the choices made, knowing that the past cannot be undone.
target: And since it is impossible to turn back time, wishing that you had done one thing instead of another.

source: paraphrase: He was a war-forged colossus, a human incarnation of devastation and chaos.
target: He was a masterpiece of war and carnage fashioned into human form.

source: paraphrase: I mean, I did make an effort to be a peaceful person and all that.
target: I mean, I did try to be a pacifist and everything.

source: paraphrase: I wasn't certain that eliminating the scoundrels would restore these areas to their former state, but I couldn't allow them to propagate this dreadful affliction throughout the entire metropolis.
target: I didn't know if killing the bastards would return these places to normal, but I couldn't let them spread this terrible blight across the whole city.

source: paraphrase: I can whip up a batch of rice gruel if you'd like.
target: Y'know, I could make rice porridge.

source: paraphrase: The prevailing situation was precisely so.

source: paraphrase: He had perpetrated an unpardonable transgression.
target: He had committed an unforgivable sin.

source: paraphrase: He had experienced this countless times before.
target: He had long since lost count of how many times he felt this.

source: paraphrase: His arms, linked to its shoulders, were behind it.
target: Past it was Cain's arms, connected to its shoulders.

source: paraphrase: Wow, you're really not grasping this, are you?
target: How thickheaded can you be?

source: paraphrase: Her frame was weighty, and her movements were restricted.
target: Her body was heavy and her mobility was limited.

source: paraphrase: Overcoming this challenge seemed utterly insurmountable.
target: There was no way of beating this thing.

source: paraphrase: This signified the achievement of one of her assigned tasks, yet.
target: This meant the completion of one of the missions given to her, but.

source: paraphrase: My apologies for the outburst.
target: Sorry for freaking out on you like that.

source: paraphrase: His location should be readily apparent.
target: As such, his whereabouts should be obvious.

source: paraphrase: I'm afraid I have another commitment, you see.
target: I have prior engagement, y'see.

source: paraphrase: The monstrosity was aggressively manipulating her chest with excessive pressure, yet its actions lacked any sort of depraved expertise.
target: The abomination was kneading her breasts with enough force to rip them off, yet lacked any sort of perverse technique behind those actions.

source: paraphrase: Aware that it would be crushed into fragments in a short time.
target: Despite knowing it'd be shattered to pieces in a matter of seconds.

source: paraphrase: The reason we keep longing for it with such intense desire.
target: Which is why we continue to yearn for it, desperately so.

source: paraphrase: The Wewelsburg Longinus exclusively targeted and claimed the Sakurai family, both its owners and its architects.
target: The Wewelsburg Longinus only consumed the Sakurai bloodline its owners and creators.

source: paraphrase: Haven't you been unusually on edge for some time now?
target: Isn't that why you have been unusually restless for a while now?

source: paraphrase: Regardless of what anyone claimed, the numerous coincidental meetings today were far too many.
target: No matter what anyone said, this was way too many chance encounters in a day.

source: paraphrase: I'd prefer not to go into it, however, the fact is.
target: I'd almost rather not explain, but, you see.

source: paraphrase: Dismissing her entire being.
target: That would be like denying her whole existence.

source: paraphrase: Pursue an activity that you find enjoyable and fulfilling.
target: Do something you want to do.

source: paraphrase: The silhouette of Beatrice dissipated into the brilliant flash of light once more.
target: With those words, Beatrice's figure vanished into lightning once again.

source: paraphrase: Walter hesitated to question the presence of a young individual, but ultimately decided to refrain from voicing his inquiry.
target: Walter was about to ask what a mere child was doing there, but ultimately swallowed his words.

source: paraphrase: He would remain steadfast in his commitment.
target: And so, he would stay true to it.

source: paraphrase: I was famished, my appearance was disheveled, and I likely had dark circles under my eyes, but none of that was of any consequence.
target: I hadn't eaten, my hair was a mess, and I probably had bags under my eyes, but none of it mattered.

source: paraphrase: Wilhelm, utilizing the energy of their forward motion, flung Kei's limp form aside as if it were a soulless toy.
target: Wilhelm, borrowing strength from the their momentum, tossed Kei's body aside like a lifeless doll.

source: paraphrase: You've now evened the score on the deceit, haven't you, Ren?
target: Now you're even on the deception, right, Ren?

source: paraphrase: Himuro shouted out my name from the rear.
target: Himuro called out to me from behind.

source: paraphrase: I had a hazy notion about one, but I was completely oblivious to the rest.
target: I had a vague guess about one, but I had no idea about the other three.

source: paraphrase: The sorcerer crooned every syllable.
target: Meanwhile, the magician sung each word.

source: paraphrase: He traversed a distance of approximately ten meters in a single bound, soaring up to the level of the fourth story of the school building.
target: He covered up to ten meters in a single jump, reaching above the fourth floor of the school.

source: paraphrase: The scoundrel somehow managed to avoid hearing impairment despite his advanced years.
target: You'd expect the bastard would've escaped hearing loss as he did aging.

source: paraphrase: The man articulated the statement with unwavering conviction, his voice devoid of emotion yet imbued with unparalleled significance.
target: He spoke the words without hesitation; his tone was flat, yet imbued with unmatched gravity.

source: paraphrase: The air abruptly materialized with scores of spikes that swiftly enveloped Shirou, transforming him into a human receptacle for the sharp protrusions.
target: Dozens of stakes suddenly sprouted out of thin air all around Shirou and pierced him in an instant, turning him into a human pincushion.

source: paraphrase: The two individuals mentioned are Valeria Trifa and Lisa Brenner.
target: Valeria Trifa and Lisa Brenner.

source: paraphrase: The exact same coastline that had been haunting my dreams every single night ever since I left the service.
target: The very same shoreline from the dream I'd been having every night since I was discharged.

source: paraphrase: That's how I genuinely expressed myself.
target: That was how I truly felt.

source: paraphrase: Despite her own gender, Beatrice was nonetheless enthralled by the allure of her adversary.
target: Despite being a woman herself, Beatrice could not help but be captivated by the beauty of her opponent.

source: paraphrase: The young warrior, Kei, drew her blade from its scabbard and leveled the sharp edge at the priest's throat.
target: Kei unsheathed her sword, and pointed it at the priest's neck.

source: paraphrase: This fellow, who now goes by the name Alessandro di Cagliostro, was utterly captivated by her very essence.
target: This man, currently known as Alessandro di Cagliostro, was swept away by her very being.

source: paraphrase: She was surely referring to Father Trifa when she mentioned 'him'.
target: By "him", she must have meant Father Trifa.

source: paraphrase: They don't wish for you to endure anguish.
target: They wouldn't want you to suffer.

source: paraphrase: Propelled by rage and frustration, I was swept up in a tide of resolute determination.
target: Driven on by anger and vexation, waves of a comforting defiance surged within me.

source: paraphrase: That would be going too far.
target: Th-That would be taking it too far.

source: paraphrase: I had believed that to be the case, but I was mistaken.
target: Or so I had thought, but I was wrong.

source: paraphrase: He harbored an enduring affection for them.
target: He still loved them.

source: paraphrase: The world around me momentarily dimmed.
target: My vision grew dark for a moment.

source: paraphrase: She also had visitors.
target: And she had company, too.

source: paraphrase: No one, not even Kasumi, is the one.
target: Neither Kasumi, nor anyone else.

source: paraphrase: I attempted to firmly adhere to irrefutable reasoning.
target: I tried to resolutely cling to unfalsifiable logic.

source: paraphrase: We permit Valhalla's manifestation to occur.
target: We allow Valhalla's emanation to come to pass.

source: paraphrase: I would cherish Marie in a manner that would make her radiate, even within the unpalatable scheme he devised for us.
target: I would love Marie in a way that would make her shine even in the distasteful plot he set out for us.

source: paraphrase: She wouldn't be able to hide anything from Ren for long.
target: Ren would see through her in a second.

source: paraphrase: That's not just a coincidence.
target: There's a reason for that.

source: paraphrase: I was on the verge of collapsing.
target: I felt like I was about to fall right there.

source: paraphrase: A weapon that demands no physical might to operate.
target: One that required no strength to be wielded.

source: paraphrase: The majestic features and formidable jaws of the creature.
target: The Mane and Fangs of the Beast.

source: paraphrase: Battling the relentless migraine, I gently raised my quivering hand.
target: Enduring the splitting headache, I slowly lifted my still-trembling hand.

source: paraphrase: It's not a matter of the odds, I simply have to prevail in this.
target: It's not about the probability of victory I just have to win this.

source: paraphrase: The brilliant sunlight overwhelmed my sight, its radiant beams shimmering like golden specks as they filtered through the strands of Marie's hair.
target: Dazzling sunlight flooded my vision, its rays appearing like golden dust as they beamed through Marie's locks.

source: paraphrase: I could wholeheartedly embrace that belief.
target: I could now believe in that with the entirety of my heart and soul.

source: paraphrase: A hackneyed storyline commonly found in mystery books and similar works.
target: The sort of clich plot you see in mystery novels and the like.

source: paraphrase: He yearned for the object to vanish, never to be seen by him once more.
target: He wished for the thing to disappear, and never show itself in front of him again.

source: paraphrase: Seems like something else has been taken away from me, doesn't it?
target: Looks like yet another thing was taken from me, huh?

source: paraphrase: They had accepted her account of his demise as true.
target: She'd told her comrades he had died, and they believed her story.

source: paraphrase: She considered him a peculiar individual, which was among the primary factors contributing to her perspective.
target: That was one of the main reasons she thought him an odd man.

source: paraphrase: The sheer number of them was overwhelming, defying her attempt to keep track; the immensity of it all filled her with a sense of unease.
target: So many that she couldn't count them all; so vast it scared her.

source: paraphrase: Through my connection with Ren, I can physically interact with anyone, and they would reciprocate that interaction.
target: With Ren, I can touch anyone and they would touch me, too.

source: paraphrase: That would be the extent of your transgressions, if you have committed any.
target: So if you do have any sin, that would be it.

source: paraphrase: The weight of his words lingered, a promise of his return should I fall short, a curse engraved upon my very essence.
target: He had left me with a promise of his return, should I fail to prove the thoroughness of my victory, his words like a curse etched onto my soul.

source: paraphrase: You attend the educational institution.
target: You go to the school.

source: paraphrase: I came from a dismal and impoverished place, so I have no knowledge or experience regarding that matter.
target: I was born in a complete shithole, so I don't know piss about that.

source: paraphrase: My thoughts were in disarray, a clear indication of my unsettled mental state.
target: My mind was all over the place a clear evidence of my unstable consciousness.

source: paraphrase: The vile and repugnant beings were steadily approaching, intent on making physical contact.
target: And yet, these disgusting subhumans were closing in for the touch.

source: paraphrase: Allow me to reframe your previous inquiry.
target: Let me throw your earlier question back at you.

source: paraphrase: Suddenly, someone obstructed my path.
target: Just then, someone blocked my way.

source: paraphrase: She stood tall, her gaze fixed on him with the intensity of one who regards a foe.
target: Marie stood proud and glared at him as one would glare at an enemy.

source: paraphrase: I was just about to take action.
target: I was about to do right now.

source: paraphrase: Her continued existence is essential to your objectives, is it not?
target: You need her alive, don't you?

source: paraphrase: It wasn't about either of us choosing to give up or lose consciousness or anything like that.
target: It wasn't a matter of one of us deciding to surrender or passing out or whatever.

source: paraphrase: Individuals who stubbornly refuse to surrender are pitiful.
target: Men that don't know when to give up are pathetic.

source: paraphrase: I have no desire to encounter her once more in the role of one of your subordinates.
target: I don't want to meet her again as one of your slaves.

source: paraphrase: Lisa, dear, it's you who should depart.
target: Sister Lisa, you're the one who needs to leave.

source: paraphrase: The woman gestured towards a man and a female companion who were positioned a short way off.
target: Marie pointed to a man and woman a short distance away.

source: paraphrase: It was also Sakurai's.
target: Also, it was Sakurai's.

source: paraphrase: That letter we received just came to mind.
target: I've just remembered this letter we got.

source: paraphrase: She found it impossible to convey that to her.
target: She couldn't tell her.

source: paraphrase: The story was of mice and youngsters in an urban setting, all captivated by the haunting melody of a mischievous flute, ultimately being swept away.
target: It was the tale of mice and children in a city who were all lured by the sound of a devilish flute, only to be whisked away.

source: paraphrase: I'm profoundly let down, to be completely truthful.
target: I myself am gravely disappointed, in all honesty.

source: paraphrase: A fresh realm where all was at the starting point.
target: A new world where everything was at zero.

source: paraphrase: This may not be exactly as you envisioned, but it's the reality you wished for.
target: True, it got a bit distorted because I threw myself into the mix, but this is the world you wanted?

source: paraphrase: I lacked the proper language to convey the profound distress I was experiencing.
target: I possessed no words strong enough to express the inner turmoil inside me.

source: paraphrase: The might I possessed was all-encompassing.
target: My power was omnidirectional.

source: paraphrase: You won't break free from my confinement.
target: You shan't escape my cage.

source: paraphrase: The entire world would be insignificant in comparison to their power.
target: Even the whole planet would be nothing against them!

source: paraphrase: There was no need for her to reveal her private information merely to boast.
target: There was no reason for her to unveil her secrets just so she could gloat.

source: paraphrase: The action you took was akin to, well.
target: What you did is more like, uh.

source: paraphrase: He appeared to be an absurd individual to work with, but such bizarre changes in the circumstances were only apparent in a twisted reality.
target: He seemed like a ludicrous person to cooperate with, but such crazy shifts in the situation were only obvious in a reality this warped.

source: paraphrase: I had a feeling that if I searched more thoroughly, I would eventually locate our trusty friend Twitsumi swinging from one of those trees, dangling upside down like an unusually large primate.
target: If I looked harder, I expected to eventually spot good ol' Twitsumi hanging upside down from one of those trees like an oversized monkey.

source: paraphrase: Do you have an issue with that?
target: Got a problem with that?

source: paraphrase: Beatrice met her demise at the hands of hired killers dispatched to target him.
target: Beatrice lost her life to assassins sent after him.

source: paraphrase: The club's operations have been put on hold for some time, I believed.
target: I thought club activities were suspended for a while.

source: paraphrase: This item may seem like a replica, but don't let that fool you – it still packs a punch.
target: This one might be a mere imitation, but that doesn't mean you should underestimate its power.

source: paraphrase: The machines and Eleonore responded in a similar fashion.
target: Machina and Eleonore also reacted accordingly.

source: paraphrase: They needed to be ready to confront their latest adversary in optimal condition.
target: They had to be prepared to face their new enemy in the best shape possible.

source: paraphrase: Every remaining individual would simply echo the same sentiment.
target: All survivors would merely repeat the same thing.

source: paraphrase: You're entitled to your own perspective on the matter.
target: You may think of Him that way.

source: paraphrase: My mind just starts whirling and whirling whenever I try to figure out what to say or how to express myself.
target: Every time I think about what to say or what kind of face to make, my head just starts spinning in circles.

source: paraphrase: He's suggesting that your appearance has a distinctive flavor.
target: He means that your face has a special taste.

source: paraphrase: They view us as mere hindrances, mere impediments on their path to their ultimate goal.
target: That's why those bastards see us as nothing but mere obstacles in the way to the finish line.

source: paraphrase: Caught in a predicament, I found it increasingly challenging to evade the constraints.
target: Finding myself essentially trapped, it grew all the more difficult to keep dodging the chains.

source: paraphrase: How did he manage to fit that in?
target: When did he have time for that?

source: paraphrase: However, don't forget what I've already mentioned.
target: But remember what I said.

source: paraphrase: And after an indeterminate period, I regained my clarity, only to find myself captivated by the lunar glow.
target: And so, after god knows how much time, I finally came to my senses, only to find myself gazing up at the moon.

source: paraphrase: The school's wall to our right unexpectedly collapsed, as if struck by a massive force.
target: The school's wall on our right suddenly caved in, as if hit by a giant hammer.

source: paraphrase: The sacred spear of golden devastation rushed at her with Schreiber's swiftness, Eleonore's accuracy, and Machina's absolute deadliness.
target: The Holy Lance of golden destruction soared towards her with Schreiber's speed, Eleonore's precision, and Machina's all-ending lethality.

source: paraphrase: That amount of blood really caught me off guard.
target: I was surprised by how much blood there was too.

source: paraphrase: I'm not imposing myself.

target: The spot in the sky was the throne and to reach it, one had to conquer three layers of Hell.

source: paraphrase: I wish these moments could last forever.
target: I don't want these days to end.

source: paraphrase: I weakly reclined on the earth, extending my extremities.
target: I feebly lied down on the ground, spreading my limbs out.

source: paraphrase: The presence of this darkness brings everything to a complete standstill.
target: Anything that touches this shadow stops dead in its tracks.

source: paraphrase: Erase all your recollections of me as well.
target: Forget everything about me too.

source: paraphrase: I'll keep the door unlatched, so when you've finished your conversation with her, have her head over to my residence, alright?
target: I'll leave the door unlocked, so when you're done talking to her, have her come to my place, okay?

source: paraphrase: The area was far too vast for just the three of us.
target: It was simply way too much space for three people.

source: paraphrase: The statement stirred a query that had nearly slipped my mind.
target: Those words sparked a question I'd almost forgotten.
